facts.fact: Sabatini Building and Nouvel Building The Museo’s main site has two access points, the Sabatini Building and Nouvel Building, both of which are the starting point of your visit and enable you to familiarise yourself with the different floors and exhibition rooms. Location and access . It is recommended entering via the Nouvel Building (C/Ronda de Atocha, 2)
